a.title: Amazon's new Alexa Tablets drop the Fire branding but are more Android than ever

b.lede: In an interview with Bloomberg, Amazon's head of consumer electronics, Panos Panay, confirmed the company would phase out the Fire brand in favor of Alexa Tablets.
